Five Star Ready with Doug Browne and Melissa Kandel

The Talk Chamber
3d ago • 33 mins
What makes a hotel stay unforgettable? According to Doug Browne, president of Peabody Hotel Resorts, it isn't the Ducks or the lobby ceiling. It's the people. Doug joins Melissa Kandel of OrthoSouth to talk about how the Peabody has built a team with remarkably low turnover, why hiring for culture matters more than technical skill, and how empowering every associate to make things right keeps guests coming back.
Along the way, Doug shares a few of his favorite WOW stories, the daily rituals that keep the whole team connected, and what it looks like when a service mishap gets turned into a win. Melissa brings it home with what other industries, including healthcare, can learn from hospitality, and both guests share their own recent customer service wins.

From Prank to Tradition with Peabody DuckMaster Kenon Walker

The Talk Chamber
Sep 2 2026 • 35 mins
Taylor Ann sits down with Kenon Walker — Memphis's one and only Duckmaster at The Peabody Memphis — for the full story behind the city's most famous residents. Kenon walks through how the tradition began in 1933,  and how bellman Edward Pembroke turned that into the now-famous Duck March ceremony in 1940, coining the "Duckmaster" title itself. Whether you've caught the Duck March a hundred times or have never made it over to the Peabody lobby, this conversation is a joyful, behind-the-scenes look at one of Memphis's most beloved traditions — and the man carrying it forward.
